title: How spaced repetition works
intro: Every card and lesson has its own review schedule. Each time you review one, you rate how well you remembered it on a 1-5 scale, and that rating decides how long JpecLearner waits before showing it to you again.

again.label: 1 · Again
again.description: You didn't remember at all. Resets progress: back to a 1-day interval and repetition count drops to zero.

hard.label: 2 · Hard
hard.description: You got it, but it was a struggle. Progress isn't reset, but the next interval only grows a little and the ease factor drops.

good.label: 3 · Good
good.description: You remembered it with normal effort. This is the standard case that grows the interval.

easy.label: 4 · Easy
easy.description: You remembered it comfortably. The interval grows a bit more than Good.

perfect.label: 5 · Perfect
perfect.description: Instant, effortless recall. The interval grows the most and the ease factor increases.

intervalsIntro: "Interval" is the number of days until a card comes back due. On a Good/Easy/Perfect rating:

intervalSteps.later: Every review after that: previous interval × ease factor (rounded), capped at {{maxDays}} days

easeIntro: Each card also tracks its own "ease factor", starting at {{defaultEase}}. It's the multiplier used in the step above — a higher ease means faster-growing intervals for cards you find easy, a lower one means slower growth for cards you struggle with. It never drops below {{minEase}}.

easeChanges.goodEasyPerfect: Good / Easy / Perfect: ease adjusts up or down slightly depending on exactly how easy it felt
easeChanges.hard: Hard: ease decreases by {{penalty}}, interval only grows ×{{multiplier}} instead of resetting
easeChanges.again: Again: ease decreases by {{penalty}}, interval resets to 1 day and the repetition streak restarts from zero

levelsIntro: A card's level (shown throughout the app) is derived directly from its current interval — the longer you've successfully gone without forgetting it, the higher its level.
levelStart: Level {{level}} · {{name}} — the starting level for every new card
levelThreshold: Level {{level}} · {{name}} — reached once the interval is at least {{days}} day(s)
